summary: Iteration 4 (Hayah Energy rebrand + new project fields + analytics) fully validated. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases PASS (20 regression + 10 new tests covering billing_value/project_type/requires_hot_line/shutdown_info fields, GET /api/projects filters by team_id and date range, dashboard total_billing, and NEW /api/analytics/production endpoint with grouping/filters/auth). Frontend Playwright: 30/30 UI checks PASS — HAYAH ENERGY branding visible on LoginPage + sidebar + header (2 hayah-logo instances), corporate phrase present, all 5 stat cards render (including stat-card-billing showing R$ 21.500,75 aggregated correctly), ProjectFilters (start/end date + team) work and reset restores, sidebar-analytics-button toggles AnalyticsCharts on/off/on, AnalyticsCharts renders 8 SVG elements (BarChart + PieChart via recharts), ProjectDrawer new fields (project-type-select, project-billing-input, project-shutdown-input, project-hotline-toggle) all functional, ProjectTable displays new columns (Tipo=Obra Nova, Faturamento=R$, Desligamento=Circuito 12..., LV=Zap icon rendered).

minor.issue: Date filter parses strings via slicing [:10] which works only for ISO-like formats. Not a bug for current app (frontend sends YYYY-MM-DD) but fragile if formats change.
by_status only counts active/paused; if new statuses added later they will be silently dropped. Pre-existing minor.

issues: Uses native browser <input type='date'> which renders locale 'mm/dd/yyyy' placeholder. Pre-existing, cosmetic — consider shadcn Calendar component for pt-BR UX.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: migrate ProjectDrawer/ProjectFilters date fields from native input to shadcn Calendar for pt-BR consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_project_response helper (lines 305-323) correctly uses .get() with defaults for all new fields (billing_value, project_type, requires_hot_line, shutdown_info), ensuring backward compat with older documents in Mongo that lack these fields. Verified via tests.

server.py /api/analytics/production (lines 446-519) correctly filters by team_id + date range and returns the exact shape the frontend AnalyticsCharts consumes (by_team array, by_type array with pt-BR labels, by_status dict, hot_line_count, total_projects).
DashboardPage.jsx applies filters both server-side (query params on /analytics) and client-side (useMemo filteredProjects) — no double-fetching, no state drift.
AnalyticsCharts.jsx handles empty state (teamData.length === 0 and pieData.length === 0 -> 'Sem dados para exibir') preventing recharts crashes on empty analytics.
ProjectDrawer hotline-toggle is a real checkbox (accessible) wrapped in a styled label so screen readers still work — good pattern.
server.py file size is now 571 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting auth/teams/projects/analytics into separate routers if it grows further.
